patterns.note: A full-width, dense grid of historical black and white photographs is used as a primary visual storytelling element, appearing after a significant text block.
Main content, including the 'A long history' narrative, is presented within a centered, narrow text column, creating an editorial and focused reading experience.
A consistent classic serif typeface is used for all primary text content (headings and body), reinforcing a sense of history, tradition, and luxury.
A fixed header bar containing the site logo and navigation icons remains persistently visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
The design predominantly uses a sophisticated off-white background with dark text, creating a clean and elegant canvas, with minimal use of a single accent color for subtle branding elements.

technique_notes: The header bar is implemented with a fixed position, ensuring it stays at the top of the viewport during scroll, providing persistent access to navigation and branding.
The main content area utilizes a maximum width container that is horizontally centered on the page, optimizing readability for long-form text content.
Historical narrative is presented through a large, multi-paragraph text block, followed by a full-bleed, responsive grid of black and white archival photographs that fill the screen horizontally.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are moderately larger (~1.5-2x body) with the same elegant serif font, body text is generous and readable, and small uppercase sans-serif is used for utility links.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with ample line height and paragraph spacing for text blocks, contrasting with a dense, edge-to-edge photo grid.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vast, full-bleed grid of historical black and white photographs, combined with a minimalist, text-focused layout, creates a powerful sense of heritage and timeless luxury, setting it apart from typical modern hotel sites.
